name: ■ GAZMATEK & VAKɅRM Invite SPEEDING RECORDS - RAVOLUTION EDITION - 2 ROOMS ■ Chinastraat, Ghent

description: For this edition, GAZMATEK and VAKɅRM are excited to welcome SPEEDING RECORDS, a collective based in Switzerland. For the first time for us, we are organising in the famous Chinastraat in Ghent and for the occasion we'll be opening 2 rooms. Something to satisfy our favorite Ravers with Acidcore, Hardtechno, Hitech, Tribe, Forest and more !!
